## Notes

Opinion capped at +200 and -200 with reasons shown in tooltips; each point of diplomatic reputation adds +5 to alliance acceptance and +3 to vassalization; base cap of 4 diplomatic relations, 1 diplomatic power per month per relation over cap; 2 diplomats.
